' GATES OF DOOM - for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' After Jeff Minter's Hell Gate. Four laser guns run on rails round the edge of the arena, and you
' move them all at once, each pair the opposite way to each other: left / right moves the top and
' bottom guns across (one left, one right), up / down moves the side guns (one up, one down). Fire
' and all four shoot inwards together; where their lines cross are your four sights. Gates of Doom
' open in the arena and pour out demons that go for your guns: imps, wraiths, bouncing skulls,
' and fire fiends that spit fireballs. Shoot the gates shut and the demons down.
' Any gun hit is a life lost: a demon reaching it, a fireball, or the opposite gun's laser when
' the two line up. Every third wave cleared gives a life back (4 at most).
'
' Keys: Q A O P, or S X Z C, or the cursor keys (5 6 7 8): move the guns.
'       Space (or M, or Kempston fire): fire (hold it down).
'
' The arena is one Layer 2 picture (Arena.cls); the guns, the gates, the demons and the explosions
' are sprites; the shots and fireballs are moved and checked in Z80 (Bul.cls); the HUD is the
' tilemap; the sound is the AY.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const NG = 4, NE = 14, NB = 8
' sprite slots (Bul has 50-127)
Const SP_GUN = 0, SP_CROSS = 4, SP_GATE = 5, SP_EN = 9, SP_BOOM = 23, SP_CROSS2 = 31
' the guns' targets for Bul (each gun can be hit by the gun opposite)
Const BOXGUN = 20
' demons
Const K_IMP = 1, K_WRAITH = 2, K_SKULL = 3, K_FIEND = 4
' where the guns run (paper coordinates: the gun's middle)
Const GXMIN = 28, GXMAX = 228, GYMIN = 44, GYMAX = 164

Dim longText As String Max 80
' the guns: 0 top, 1 bottom, 2 left, 3 right; the top / bottom ones at x = gx, the sides at y = gy
Dim galive(3) As Integer, gunX(3) As Integer, gunY(3) As Integer
Dim gx As Integer, gy As Integer, cool As Integer, lives As Integer, hitT As Integer
' the gates: open, where, life, its most, when the next demon comes, a hit flash
Dim gon(3) As Integer, gtx(3) As Integer, gty(3) As Integer, ghp(3) As Integer, gmax(3) As Integer, gspawn(3) As Integer, gfl(3) As Integer
' the demons: kind, position and speed (16ths of a pixel), life, timer, which gun it wants, a flash
Dim ek(13) As Integer, ex(13) As Integer, ey(13) As Integer, evx(13) As Integer, evy(13) As Integer
Dim ehp(13) As Integer, et(13) As Integer, etg(13) As Integer, efl(13) As Integer
' explosions
Dim bx(7) As Integer, by(7) As Integer, bt(7) As Integer, bbig(7) As Integer, bnext As Integer
Dim score As Long, hiscore As Long, wave As Integer, over As Integer, gatesOpen As Integer, demonCount As Integer
Dim frames As Integer, msgT As Integer, scoreDirty As Integer, clearT As Integer
Dim k As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Arena.Init
Bul.Init GfxData.S_SHOT
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSUL                    ' sprites over the HUD, the HUD over the arena
Nx.Reg &H1C, 2                           ' the sprites cut to the arena (x halved: over the border)
Nx.Reg &H19, 16 : Nx.Reg &H19, 143 : Nx.Reg &H19, 48 : Nx.Reg &H19, 223
Nx.Reg &H15, Nx.RegGet(&H15) Or &H20
hiscore = 20000
Do
  Title
  Game
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the screen
Sub Hud()
  Tiles.Fill 0
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 32, 1, GfxData.T_HUD
  Tiles.Rect 4, 5, 32, 1, GfxData.T_HUDB
  ShowScore
  ShowLives
  ShowGates
  Tiles.Text 16, 4, "WAVE " & Right$("0" & Trim$(Str$(wave)), 2)
End Sub

Sub ShowScore()
  Tiles.Text 4, 4, Right$("000000" & Trim$(Str$(score)), 7)
  scoreDirty = 0
End Sub

Sub ShowLives()
  For k = 0 To 3
    If k < lives Then Tiles.Put 32 + k, 4, GfxData.T_GUN Else Tiles.Put 32 + k, 4, GfxData.T_HUD
  Next
End Sub

Sub ShowGates()
  For k = 0 To 3
    If k < gatesOpen Then Tiles.Put 25 + k, 4, GfxData.T_GATE Else Tiles.Put 25 + k, 4, GfxData.T_HUD
  Next
End Sub

Sub Message(ByVal m As String, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  longText = m
  Tiles.Rect 4, y, 32, 1, 0
  Tiles.Text 4 + (32 - Len(longText)) \ 2, y, longText
  If t Then msgT = t
End Sub

Sub ClearMessages()
  Tiles.Rect 4, 6, 32, 22, 0
End Sub

Function FireDown() As Integer
  FireDown = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub Title()
  Dim y As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 50 : Spr.Show
  Bul.Reset : Bul.Show
  wave = 1 : score = 0 : lives = 3 : hitT = 0
  For k = 0 To 3
    galive(k) = 1
  Next
  Hud
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 32, 1, GfxData.T_HUD
  Tiles.Text 4, 4, "HI " & Right$("000000" & Trim$(Str$(hiscore)), 7)
  Message "G A T E S   O F   D O O M", 9, 0
  Message "FOUR GUNS. ONE HAND.", 11, 0
  Message "LEFT/RIGHT  TOP + BOTTOM GUNS", 13, 0
  Message "UP/DOWN     THE SIDE GUNS", 14, 0
  Message "EACH PAIR GOES OPPOSITE WAYS", 15, 0
  Message "QAOP  SXZC  5678  JOYSTICK", 17, 0
  Message "SPACE  ALL FOUR FIRE", 18, 0
  Message "SHOOT THE GATES SHUT", 20, 0
  Message "ANY GUN HIT IS A LIFE LOST", 21, 0
  Message "EVEN BY ITS OWN TWIN", 22, 0
  gx = 128 : gy = 104
  y = 0
  Do
    PlaceGuns
    DrawGuns
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    y = y + 1
    gx = 128 + (y And 63) - 32
    If y = 30 Then Message "PRESS SPACE", 25, 0
    If y = 60 Then Tiles.Rect 4, 25, 32, 1, 0 : y = 0
  Loop Until FireDown()
  Do
    Frame
  Loop While FireDown()
  ClearMessages
  Sfx.Play 0, 300, -10, 15, 30, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a game
Sub Game()
  score = 0 : wave = 1 : over = 0 : lives = 3
  For k = 0 To 3
    galive(k) = 1
  Next
  Do
    WaveRun
    If over Then Exit Do
    wave = wave + 1
  Loop
  If score > hiscore Then hiscore = score
  Message "THE GATES OF DOOM HAVE WON", 13, 0
  Message "GAME OVER", 15, 0
  For k = 1 To 250
    Frame
    Sfx.Update
    If k > 50 And FireDown() Then Exit For
  Next
  ClearMessages
End Sub

Sub WaveRun()
  Dim n As Integer, b As Long
  Spr.HideRange 0, 50
  Bul.Reset
  For k = 0 To NE - 1
    ek(k) = 0
  Next
  For k = 0 To NB - 1
    bt(k) = 0
  Next
  n = 1 + wave \ 2
  If n > NG Then n = NG
  For k = 0 To NG - 1
    gon(k) = 0
    If k < n Then
      gon(k) = 1
      gtx(k) = 64 + Rnd(128) : gty(k) = 64 + Rnd(80)
      gmax(k) = 20 + wave * 4 : ghp(k) = gmax(k)
      gspawn(k) = 40 + k * 50
      gfl(k) = 0
    End If
  Next
  gatesOpen = n : demonCount = 0
  gx = 72 : gy = 70 : cool = 0 : hitT = 60
  Hud
  Message "WAVE " & Trim$(Str$(wave)), 12, 120
  If n = 1 Then Message "A GATE OF DOOM IS OPENING", 14, 120 Else Message Trim$(Str$(n)) & " GATES OF DOOM ARE OPENING", 14, 120
  Sfx.Play 2, 400, 6, 15, 60, 0
  clearT = 0
  Do
    GunsMove
    Gates
    Demons
    Booms
    Bul.Step 0, 0, 0
    GunHits
    DrawGuns
    If scoreDirty And (frames And 3) = 0 Then ShowScore
    If msgT > 0 Then
      msgT = msgT - 1
      If msgT = 0 Then ClearMessages
    End If
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Bul.Show
    Sfx.Update
    frames = frames + 1
    If lives = 0 Then
      clearT = clearT + 1
      If clearT > 100 Then over = 1 : Exit Sub
    ElseIf gatesOpen = 0 And demonCount = 0 Then
      clearT = clearT + 1
      If clearT = 30 Then
        b = wave * 2000
        AddScore b
        Message "WAVE " & Trim$(Str$(wave)) & " CLEARED", 12, 0
        Message "BONUS " & Trim$(Str$(b)), 14, 0
        If (wave Mod 3) = 0 And lives < 4 Then
          lives = lives + 1 : ShowLives
          Message "AN EXTRA LIFE", 16, 0
        End If
        Sfx.Play 0, 100, -2, 15, 50, 0
      End If
      If clearT > 170 Then ClearMessages : Exit Sub
    End If
  Loop
End Sub

Sub AddScore(ByVal n As Long)
  score = score + n
  scoreDirty = 1
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the guns
Sub GunsMove()
  Dim j0 As Integer, mx As Integer, my As Integer
  j0 = Keys.Joystick(0)
  mx = 0 : my = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyLeft) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyLeft) Then mx = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyC) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyRight) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyRight) Then mx = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyS) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyUp) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyUp) Then my = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyX) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyDown) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyDown) Then my = 1
  If hitT > 0 Then hitT = hitT - 1
  gx = gx + mx * 3 : gy = gy + my * 3
  If gx < GXMIN Then gx = GXMIN
  If gx > GXMAX Then gx = GXMAX
  If gy < GYMIN Then gy = GYMIN
  If gy > GYMAX Then gy = GYMAX
  PlaceGuns
  If cool > 0 Then cool = cool - 1
  If FireDown() And cool = 0 And lives > 0 And hitT < 30 Then
    Bul.Shot gunX(0), 36, 0, 9
    Bul.Shot gunX(1), 172, 0, -9
    Bul.Shot 20, gunY(2), 9, 0
    Bul.Shot 236, gunY(3), -9, 0
    cool = 6
    Sfx.Play 0, 22, 3, 9, 4, 0
  End If
End Sub

Sub PlaceGuns()
  gunX(0) = gx : gunY(0) = 24
  gunX(1) = 256 - gx : gunY(1) = 184              ' the bottom gun goes the other way
  gunX(2) = 8 : gunY(2) = gy
  gunX(3) = 248 : gunY(3) = 208 - gy             ' the right gun goes the other way
End Sub

' the guns turned to face in: top as drawn, bottom flipped, the sides turned
Sub DrawGuns()
  For k = 0 To 3
    If lives > 0 And (hitT And 4) = 0 Then
      If k = 0 Then
        Spr.Put SP_GUN, gunX(0) + 24, gunY(0) + 24, GfxData.S_GUN, 0
      ElseIf k = 1 Then
        Spr.Put SP_GUN + 1, gunX(1) + 24, gunY(1) + 24, GfxData.S_GUN, Spr.MirrorY
      ElseIf k = 2 Then
        Spr.Put SP_GUN + 2, gunX(2) + 24, gunY(2) + 24, GfxData.S_GUN, Spr.Rotate Or Spr.MirrorX
      Else
        Spr.Put SP_GUN + 3, gunX(3) + 24, gunY(3) + 24, GfxData.S_GUN, Spr.Rotate
      End If
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_GUN + k
    End If
  Next
  ' the four places the lines cross
  Spr.Put SP_CROSS, gunX(0) + 24, gunY(2) + 24, GfxData.S_CROSS, 0
  Spr.Put SP_CROSS2, gunX(0) + 24, gunY(3) + 24, GfxData.S_CROSS, 0
  Spr.Put SP_CROSS2 + 1, gunX(1) + 24, gunY(2) + 24, GfxData.S_CROSS, 0
  Spr.Put SP_CROSS2 + 2, gunX(1) + 24, gunY(3) + 24, GfxData.S_CROSS, 0
End Sub

' a gun hit by a fireball, or by the gun opposite's laser (they line up in the middle)
Sub GunHits()
  Dim h As Integer
  For k = 0 To 3
    h = Bul.Hits(BOXGUN + k)
    If Bul.Near(gunX(k), gunY(k)) Then h = h + 1
    If h Then LoseLife k
    Bul.Box BOXGUN + k, gunX(k), gunY(k), 7, 7
  Next
End Sub

' any gun hit: a life gone; the demons and fireballs cleared
Sub LoseLife(ByVal g As Integer)
  Dim m As Integer
  If hitT > 0 Or lives = 0 Then Exit Sub
  lives = lives - 1 : ShowLives
  hitT = 90
  Boom gunX(g), gunY(g), 1
  m = Bul.Clear()
  For m = 0 To NE - 1
    If ek(m) Then
      Boom ex(m) \ 16, ey(m) \ 16, 0
      ek(m) = 0 : Bul.Off m : Spr.Hide SP_EN + m
    End If
  Next
  demonCount = 0
  Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 60, 1
  Sfx.Play 1, 300, 10, 15, 40, 0
  If lives > 0 Then Message "A GUN IS HIT!", 17, 80
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the gates
Sub Gates()
  Dim n As Integer, h As Integer, fl As Integer, m As Integer, kd As Integer, r As Integer
  For n = 0 To NG - 1
    If gon(n) Then
      h = Bul.Hits(16 + n)
      If h > 0 Then
        ghp(n) = ghp(n) - h : gfl(n) = 1
        AddScore 10 * h
        Sfx.Play 1, 50, -3, 11, 4, 0
        If ghp(n) <= 0 Then
          gon(n) = 0 : gatesOpen = gatesOpen - 1 : ShowGates
          Bul.Off 16 + n
          Spr.Hide SP_GATE + n
          Boom gtx(n), gty(n), 1
          Boom gtx(n) - 12, gty(n) - 10, 0
          Boom gtx(n) + 12, gty(n) + 8, 0
          AddScore 1000 * wave
          Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 50, 1
          Sfx.Play 0, 500, -12, 15, 40, 0
        End If
      End If
      If gon(n) Then
        Bul.Box 16 + n, gtx(n), gty(n), 15, 15
        ' hit: it glows red-hot for a frame (and stays red-hot when nearly shut)
        If gfl(n) Or ghp(n) * 3 < gmax(n) Then fl = Spr.Pal * 2 Else fl = 0
        gfl(n) = 0
        Spr.Put SP_GATE + n, gtx(n) + 16, gty(n) + 16, GfxData.S_GATE + ((frames \ 4) And 3), fl Or Spr.Scale2
        ' it sends out a demon now and then
        gspawn(n) = gspawn(n) - 1
        If gspawn(n) <= 0 Then
          r = 120 - wave * 10
          If r < 40 Then r = 40
          gspawn(n) = r + Rnd(50)
          r = Rnd(10)
          kd = K_IMP
          If wave >= 2 And r >= 6 Then kd = K_WRAITH
          If wave >= 3 And r = 8 Then kd = K_SKULL
          If wave >= 4 And r = 9 Then kd = K_FIEND
          m = Spawn(kd, gtx(n), gty(n))
          If wave >= 5 Then m = Spawn(K_IMP, gtx(n), gty(n))
          If m >= 0 Then Sfx.Play 2, 200, -8, 12, 16, 0
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the demonCount
Function Spawn(ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
  Dim m As Integer, g As Integer, t As Integer
  For m = 0 To NE - 1
    If ek(m) = 0 Then
      ek(m) = kd : ex(m) = x * 16 : ey(m) = y * 16 : et(m) = 0 : efl(m) = 0
      ' it wants a gun that's still there
      g = Rnd(4)
      For t = 1 To 4
        If galive(g) = 0 Then g = (g + 1) And 3
      Next
      etg(m) = g
      evx(m) = Rnd(33) - 16 : evy(m) = Rnd(33) - 16
      If kd = K_IMP Then ehp(m) = 1
      If kd = K_WRAITH Then ehp(m) = 2
      If kd = K_SKULL Then
        ehp(m) = 3 : evx(m) = 20 + wave * 2 : evy(m) = 16 + wave * 2
        If Rnd(2) Then evx(m) = -evx(m)
      End If
      If kd = K_FIEND Then ehp(m) = 8
      demonCount = demonCount + 1
      Spawn = m
      Exit Function
    End If
  Next
  Spawn = -1
End Function

Sub Demons()
  Dim m As Integer, kd As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, h As Integer, fl As Integer, pat As Integer
  Dim tx As Integer, ty As Integer, sp As Integer, g As Integer, a As Integer
  For m = 0 To NE - 1
    kd = ek(m)
    If kd Then
      x = ex(m) \ 16 : y = ey(m) \ 16
      g = etg(m)
      If galive(g) = 0 Then
        g = (g + 1) And 3
        etg(m) = g
      End If
      tx = gunX(g) : ty = gunY(g)
      sp = 20 + wave * 3
      If kd = K_IMP Then
        ' homes in, wobbling
        If tx > x Then evx(m) = evx(m) + 2 Else evx(m) = evx(m) - 2
        If ty > y Then evy(m) = evy(m) + 2 Else evy(m) = evy(m) - 2
        evx(m) = Clamp(evx(m), sp) : evy(m) = Clamp(evy(m), sp)
      ElseIf kd = K_WRAITH Then
        ' straight at it, faster, swaying
        If tx > x Then evx(m) = evx(m) + 4 Else evx(m) = evx(m) - 4
        If ty > y Then evy(m) = evy(m) + 4 Else evy(m) = evy(m) - 4
        evx(m) = Clamp(evx(m), sp + 10) : evy(m) = Clamp(evy(m), sp + 10)
      ElseIf kd = K_SKULL Then
        ' bounces round the whole arena, spitting now and then
        If (x < 12 And evx(m) < 0) Or (x > 244 And evx(m) > 0) Then evx(m) = -evx(m)
        If (y < 28 And evy(m) < 0) Or (y > 180 And evy(m) > 0) Then evy(m) = -evy(m)
        If (et(m) Mod 120) = 119 Then Spit x, y, g
      Else
        ' drifts slowly, spitting fire
        If tx > x Then evx(m) = evx(m) + 1 Else evx(m) = evx(m) - 1
        If ty > y Then evy(m) = evy(m) + 1 Else evy(m) = evy(m) - 1
        evx(m) = Clamp(evx(m), 8) : evy(m) = Clamp(evy(m), 8)
        If (et(m) Mod 70) = 69 Then Spit x, y, g
      End If
      ex(m) = ex(m) + evx(m) : ey(m) = ey(m) + evy(m)
      et(m) = et(m) + 1
      x = ex(m) \ 16 : y = ey(m) \ 16
      If x < 4 Then x = 4 : ex(m) = 64
      If x > 251 Then x = 251 : ex(m) = 251 * 16
      If y < 20 Then y = 20 : ey(m) = 320
      If y > 187 Then y = 187 : ey(m) = 187 * 16
      ' shot
      h = Bul.Hits(m)
      If h > 0 Then
        ehp(m) = ehp(m) - h : efl(m) = 1
        If ehp(m) <= 0 Then
          KillDemon m, kd, x, y
          kd = 0
        End If
      End If
      If kd Then
        ' at a gun: the gun and the demon both go
        For a = 0 To 3
          If galive(a) Then
            If Abs(x - gunX(a)) < 11 And Abs(y - gunY(a)) < 11 Then
              LoseLife a
              If ek(m) Then ek(m) = 0 : demonCount = demonCount - 1 : Bul.Off m : Spr.Hide SP_EN + m
              Boom x, y, 0
              kd = 0
              Exit For
            End If
          End If
        Next
      End If
      If kd Then
        If kd = K_FIEND Then Bul.Box m, x, y, 14, 14 Else Bul.Box m, x, y, 8, 8
        If efl(m) Then fl = Spr.Pal : efl(m) = 0 Else fl = 0
        If kd = K_IMP Then
          Spr.Put SP_EN + m, x + 24, y + 24, GfxData.S_IMP + ((frames \ 4) And 1), fl
        ElseIf kd = K_WRAITH Then
          Spr.Put SP_EN + m, x + 24, y + 24, GfxData.S_WRAITH + ((frames \ 6) And 1), fl
        ElseIf kd = K_SKULL Then
          Spr.Put SP_EN + m, x + 24, y + 24, GfxData.S_SKULL, fl
        Else
          Spr.Put SP_EN + m, x + 16, y + 16, GfxData.S_FIEND + ((et(m) \ 10) And 1), fl Or Spr.Scale2
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Function Clamp(ByVal v As Integer, ByVal lim As Integer) As Integer
  If v > lim Then
    Clamp = lim
  ElseIf v < -lim Then
    Clamp = -lim
  Else
    Clamp = v
  End If
End Function

' a fireball from x, y at gun g
Sub Spit(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal g As Integer)
  Dim sp As Integer
  If galive(g) = 0 Then Exit Sub
  sp = 16 + wave * 2
  If sp > 36 Then sp = 36
  Bul.Fire x, y, Bul.Aim(x, y, gunX(g), gunY(g)), sp, GfxData.S_FIRE, 0
  Sfx.Play 2, 80, 4, 11, 10, 1
End Sub

Sub KillDemon(ByVal m As Integer, ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  ek(m) = 0 : demonCount = demonCount - 1
  Bul.Off m
  Spr.Hide SP_EN + m
  If kd = K_FIEND Then
    Boom x, y, 1
    AddScore 500
  Else
    Boom x, y, 0
    If kd = K_IMP Then AddScore 100
    If kd = K_WRAITH Then AddScore 150
    If kd = K_SKULL Then AddScore 200
  End If
  Sfx.Play 1, 20, 1, 13, 12, 1
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- explosions
Sub Boom(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal big As Integer)
  bx(bnext) = x : by(bnext) = y : bt(bnext) = 16 : bbig(bnext) = big
  bnext = (bnext + 1) And 7
End Sub

Sub Booms()
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NB - 1
    If bt(n) > 0 Then
      bt(n) = bt(n) - 1
      If bt(n) = 0 Then
        Spr.Hide SP_BOOM + n
      ElseIf bbig(n) Then
        Spr.Put SP_BOOM + n, bx(n) + 16, by(n) + 16, GfxData.S_BOOM + (15 - bt(n)) \ 4, Spr.Scale2
      Else
        Spr.Put SP_BOOM + n, bx(n) + 24, by(n) + 24, GfxData.S_BOOM + (15 - bt(n)) \ 4, 0
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Bul.cls
files.text:
' Bul - the bullet engine: 60 enemy bullets and 18 player shots as hardware sprites 50-127,
' moved, checked and drawn in Z80 every frame. (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' This copy is for GATES OF DOOM: the play area is the whole 256 x 192 paper (under a 16 pixel
' HUD); shots fly any of the four ways (the pan is 0). Coordinates are the paper's (0-255 across, 0-191 down; Show adds 24 to put
' them on the sprites' screen). Positions are centres.
' Enemy bullets move in 1/256ths of a pixel (an angle and a speed: Fire); they go when they leave
' the play area (rows 20-187 - the HUD is above). Step tells you if one is on the player (within
' 5 pixels of the centre).
' Shots fly vx across and vy down a frame and hit boxes: up to 24
' targets Main puts down each frame (Box n, x, y, half width, half height), each counting its hits
' until Hits(n) reads them.
' Step's pan is how far the view moved this frame (pixels, + right): everything flying moves the
' other way with the ground.
' A frame:  Bul.Step px, py, pan  (moves all, writes the sprites' table)
'           Frame : Bul.Show (the table to the hardware)
Option Explicit

Private eb(599) As Byte           ' 60 bullets x 10: x (lo, hi), y (lo, hi), vx, vy, pattern (255 = none), palette
Private sh(89) As Byte            ' 18 shots x 5: x, y, vx, vy, on
Private bx(143) As Byte           ' 24 boxes x 6: on, x, y, half width, half height, hits
Private att(389) As Byte          ' 78 sprites x 5
Private hitF As Integer, live As Integer, spk As Integer, spkX As Integer, spkY As Integer
Private cnt As Integer, ang As Integer, tmp As Integer, vx As Integer, vy As Integer
Private sa3 As Integer, sa4 As Integer, six As Integer
Private atn(16) As Integer

' Init shotPattern: everything cleared, the shots' sprite pattern
Public Sub Init(ByVal shotPattern As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer
  sa3 = &HC0 Or (shotPattern \ 2)
  sa4 = &H80 Or ((shotPattern And 1) * 64)
  ' atan(k / 16) in 256ths of a turn
  atn(0) = 0 : atn(1) = 3 : atn(2) = 5 : atn(3) = 8 : atn(4) = 10 : atn(5) = 12 : atn(6) = 15 : atn(7) = 17
  atn(8) = 19 : atn(9) = 21 : atn(10) = 23 : atn(11) = 25 : atn(12) = 26 : atn(13) = 28 : atn(14) = 29
  atn(15) = 31 : atn(16) = 32
  tmp = Sines()
  Reset
End Sub

' Reset: no bullets, no shots, no boxes
Public Sub Reset()
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 10
            ld b, 60
rs_b:
            ld (hl), 255
            add hl, de
            djnz rs_b
            ld hl, {sh}
            ld b, 90
rs_s:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_s
            ld hl, {bx}
            ld b, 144
rs_x:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_x
            ld hl, {att}
            ld b, 78
rs_a:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #40
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_a
#endasm
End Sub

' Clear(): every enemy bullet gone (a bomb, a boss beaten): how many there were
Public Function Clear() As Integer
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 10
            ld bc, 60 * 256
cl_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, cl_n
            ld (hl), 255
            inc c
cl_n:
            add hl, de
            djnz cl_lp
            pop hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fire x, y, a, spd, pat, pal: an enemy bullet from x, y going way a (0-255: 0 down, 64 right,
' 128 up, 192 left) at spd sixteenths of a pixel a frame, sprite pattern pat in palette pal
Public Sub Fire(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal spd As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal pal As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_x + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_y + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({ang}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_s1 + 1), a
            ld (fi_s2 + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_p + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld (fi_c + 1), a
            ld hl, {eb} + 8         ; a free one
            ld de, 10
            ld b, 60
fi_find:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, fi_got
            add hl, de
            djnz fi_find
            jp fi_done
fi_got:
            ld de, -8
            add hl, de
            ld ({tmp}), hl
            ld a, ({ang})           ; vx = sin(a) * spd / 8
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, fi_n1
            inc h
fi_n1:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, fi_p1
            neg
fi_p1:
            ld d, a
fi_s1:
            ld e, 0
fi_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e

' Step px, py, pan: every bullet and shot moved (the view moved pan pixels), checked, put in the
' sprites' table
Public Sub Step(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer, ByVal pan As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_px + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_py + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_pan + 1), a
            ld (ss_pan + 1), a
            ld ({six}), ix
            xor a
            ld ({hitF}), a
            ld ({live}), a
            ld ({spk}), a
            ld ix, {eb}
            ld de, {att}
            ld a, 60
            ld ({cnt}), a
st_lp:
            ld a, (ix + 8)
            cp 255
            jp z, st_free
            ld c, a                 ; the pattern
            ld a, (ix + 0)          ; x += vx - pan
            add a, (ix + 4)
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            adc a, (ix + 5)
st_pan:
            sub 0
            ld (ix + 1), a
            cp 4
            jr c, st_kill
            cp 252
            jr nc, st_kill
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; y += vy
            add a, (ix + 6)
            ld (ix + 2), a
            ld a, (ix + 3)
            adc a, (ix + 7)
            ld (ix + 3), a
            cp 20
            jr c, st_kill
            cp 188
            jr nc, st_kill
st_py:
            sub 0                   ; on the player: within 5 both ways
            add a, 5
            cp 11
            jr nc, st_nohit
            ld a, (ix + 1)
st_px:
            sub 0
            add a, 5
            cp 11
            jr nc, st_nohit
            ld a, 1
            ld ({hitF}), a
st_nohit:
            ld hl, {live}
            inc (hl)
            ld a, (ix + 1)          ; the sprite: x + 24 (9 bits), y + 24
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            sbc a, a
            and 1
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ix + 3)
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, (ix + 9)
            or b
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            jr st_next
st_kill:
            ld (ix + 8), 255
st_free:
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, #40
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
st_next:
            ld bc, 10
            add ix, bc
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, st_lp
            ; ---- the shots
            ld ix, {sh}
            ld a, 18
            ld ({cnt}), a
ss_lp:
            ld a, (ix + 4)
            or a
            jp z, ss_free
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; x += vx - pan (it goes when it wraps or leaves)
ss_pan:
            sub 0
            ld c, a
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            add a, c
            ld (ix + 0), a
            bit 7, c
            jr nz, ss_neg
            jp c, ss_kill
            jr ss_chk
ss_neg:
            jp nc, ss_kill
ss_chk:
            cp 4
            jp c, ss_kill
            cp 252
            jp nc, ss_kill
            ld c, (ix + 3)          ; y += vy
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            add a, c
            ld (ix + 1), a
            bit 7, c
            jr nz, ss_negy
            jp c, ss_kill
            jr ss_chky
ss_negy:
            jp nc, ss_kill
ss_chky:
            cp 20
            jp c, ss_kill
            cp 188
            jp nc, ss_kill
            ld hl, {bx}             ; the targets
            ld b, 24
ss_box:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, ss_skip6
            inc hl
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            sub (hl)
            jr nc, ss_ax
            neg
ss_ax:
            inc hl
            inc hl
            cp (hl)
            jr nc, ss_skip3
            dec hl
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            sub (hl)
            jr nc, ss_ay
            neg
ss_ay:
            inc hl
            inc hl
            cp (hl)
            jr nc, ss_skip4
            inc hl
            inc (hl)                ; a hit
            jr nz, ss_hc
            dec (hl)
ss_hc:
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            ld ({spkX}), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            ld ({spkY}), a
            ld a, 1
            ld ({spk}), a
            jr ss_kill
ss_skip3:
            inc hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            djnz ss_box
            jr ss_draw
ss_skip4:
            inc hl
            inc hl
            djnz ss_box
            jr ss_draw
ss_skip6:
            ld a, l
            add a, 6
            ld l, a
            jr nc, ss_nc
            inc h
ss_nc:
            djnz ss_box
ss_draw:
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            sbc a, a
            and 1
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; flying left: mirrored; up or down: turned
            and #80
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ix + 3)
            or a
            ld a, b
            jr z, ss_flat
            or 2
ss_flat:
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, ({sa3})
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, ({sa4})
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            jr ss_next
ss_kill:
            ld (ix + 4), 0
ss_free:
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, #40
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
ss_next:
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, ss_lp
            ld ix, ({six})
#endasm
End Sub

' Aim(x, y, tx, ty): the way (0-255, as Fire's) from x, y to tx, ty
Public Function Aim(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal tx As Integer, ByVal ty As Integer) As Integer
  Dim dx As Integer, dy As Integer, ax As Integer, ay As Integer, t As Integer
  dx = tx - x : dy = ty - y
  ax = Abs(dx) : ay = Abs(dy)
  If ax = 0 And ay = 0 Then
    Aim = 0
    Exit Function
  End If
  If ax <= ay Then
    t = atn(ax * 16 \ ay)
  Else
    t = 64 - atn(ay * 16 \ ax)
  End If
  If dy >= 0 Then
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = t Else Aim = (256 - t) And 255
  Else
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = 128 - t Else Aim = 128 + t
  End If
End Function
